hotspots.title: ACL Live at the Moody Theater
hotspots.subtitle: 310 Willie Nelson Blvd · home of Austin City Limits TV taping

info.description: 2,750-seat live music venue and home of the long-running Austin City Limits TV taping. Eclectic concert calendar year-round.

hotspots.title: Stubb's BBQ
hotspots.subtitle: 801 Red River St · outdoor amphitheater + indoor stage

info.description: Iconic Red River venue with an indoor stage and a 2,200-capacity outdoor amphitheater. Concerts most nights plus Sunday gospel brunch.

hotspots.title: Mohawk
hotspots.subtitle: 912 Red River St · indoor/outdoor live music club

info.description: Indoor + outdoor stages on Red River. Cornerstone of the Austin indie + punk scene. Nightly shows.

hotspots.title: Antone's Nightclub
hotspots.subtitle: 305 E 5th St · Austin's home of the blues since 1975

info.description: Legendary blues club, now in its downtown location, with national touring acts and Austin residents alike.

hotspots.title: The Long Center for the Performing Arts
hotspots.subtitle: 701 W Riverside Dr · symphony, ballet, broadway tours

info.description: Multi-stage performing arts complex on Lady Bird Lake. Home of Austin Symphony, Ballet Austin, and Austin Opera; also touring Broadway and concerts.

hotspots.title: Empire Control Room & Garage
hotspots.subtitle: 606 E 7th St · indie, electronic, and hip-hop

info.description: Two-stage venue near 7th & Red River with a strong indie/electronic booking — and a beloved outdoor garage stage.

hotspots.title: Paramount Theatre
hotspots.subtitle: 713 Congress Ave · 1915 vaudeville house, now film + concerts

info.description: Historic 1,270-seat theater on Congress hosting concerts, comedy, the Paramount Summer Classic Film Series, and SXSW screenings.

hotspots.title: Cactus Cafe
hotspots.subtitle: UT Student Union · listening-room folk + acoustic

info.description: Tiny listening-room venue on the UT campus, hosting acoustic singer-songwriters in an attentive, quiet setting since 1979.

hotspots.title: The Continental Club
hotspots.subtitle: 1315 S Congress · honky-tonk classic on SoCo

info.description: Open since 1957, Austin's classic honky-tonk + roots music room on South Congress. Sets most nights, two stages.
